dedupe_keys.name: ebre rapid magnetic variation event lists

description: Ebre Observatory hosts the International Service on Rapid Magnetic Variations for IAGA and publishes annual event lists through its current variations/rapid page. Sudden commencements are listed from 1869 and solar-flare effects from 1970, with recent preliminary entries extending into 2026. Records distinguish storm sudden commencements from sudden impulses and include event times and observatory qualification codes; content and conventions vary between historical periods. Public tables and later text files are available free under CC-BY-NC-4.0. The old article URL returns 404, but the current page is linked by ISGI and was verified. Preliminary entries and changes in event definitions limit direct historical comparison. The lists can select and validate disturbance scenarios for electricity-grid and satellite-system simulations. They complement data-gfz-kp-index and data-intermagnet with classified rapid events, not continuous field measurements.
